items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I thought it was Plum and Nelly, man, you know, one of them strictly New Orleans... Plum and Nelly up in Kip. Yeah, yeah, that's just too far when you ain't been there

ctx.x: I said, oh, I don't know. I don't know, man. I don't know. I said, I'd have to talk to my mother about that. And I said, what's the deal? He said, well, we get $30 a week. He said, playing at a nice place. He said, we got a long-term contract. If you'd be interested, say, we've been around them many places and talked to many trumpet players, but we would prefer to have you, because you fit more with the band. And now, man, I fell right in it when I fell in with them, because they liked, you know, for a man to be…
You thought it was Plum and Nelly?
